imagen.surface: dedicated image-generation model API (AI SDK image model / Vertex predict)

gemini_image.surface: generative multimodal text call; image bytes arrive as response files
gemini_image.dispatch: strategy 'text' -> generateText(..., providerOptions.google.responseModalities ['TEXT','IMAGE']) then read image parts off result.files

options.note: Deterministic reseeding has no equivalent on the multimodal surface. Dropping it silently changes reproducibility guarantees a caller may depend on.
The image surface returns n candidates per call; the text surface does not take a count.
Mask-guided edit semantics are not expressible as a multimodal prompt without changing behaviour.
Carrier for inpainting; the text path never forwards it.
No provider-level negative prompt on the multimodal surface. Folding it into the positive prompt is a behaviour change, not a mapping.
Closest analogue is `imageConfig.imageSize` ('1K' | '2K' | '4K'), which is a different value space. Requires a human decision, not a rename.
The multimodal path reports the media type it produced; it does not accept a requested container.
Supported on both surfaces; the multimodal surface accepts a wider ratio set.
Reference images move from a dedicated argument to multimodal message content.

escalation_rule: Every HUMAN_REQUIRED option that the affected call sites actually use must appear in the pull request body as an explicit capability-loss callout. A green build with a silently dropped option is a failed migration, not a passing one.
